extraTests.domain: All n,m,a,b=1..4 (256 inputs); shortest-path dynamic programming over ride counts, not quotient/remainder formula.

204691357.reason: Uses n//2 rather than n//m for bundle count and always pays the leftover rides individually. On 10 3 5 1, four bundles cost 4, not the printed 10.

204888236.reason: Never compares remainder single tickets against one additional bundle. On 10 3 5 1, prints 3*1+1*5=8 rather than four bundles costing 4.

204889258.reason: The cheap-per-ride bundle branch always buys leftover single rides. An extra bundle is cheaper on 10 3 5 1: expected 4, actual 8.

205209405.reason: Compares per-ride bundle price but omits the extra-bundle option for the remainder. Expected 4 on 10 3 5 1, actual 8.

205209819.reason: Always buys floor(n/m) bundles even when singles are cheaper. On 9 3 3 10, nine singles cost 27, but it prints 30.
